name: Blood Curse of the Marked
description:
As a Bonus Action, you mark a creature that you can see within 30 feet of you. Until the start of your next turn, whenever the cursed creature takes damage from you of the same type as one of your active crimson rites, it takes an additional hemocraft die of damage.
	**Amplify**: The cursed creature takes the additional damage when it takes damage from any source, not just you, of the same type as one of your active crimson rites.
